title: Trigonometric Ratios of Complementary Angles — Introduction to Trigonometry
hook: Let's explore Trigonometric Ratios of Complementary Angles from the chapter on Introduction to Trigonometry. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Trigonometric Ratios of Complementary Angles Two angles are complementary if they add to 90°. Key identities: sin(90°−θ) = cos θ, cos(90°−θ) = sin θ, tan(90°−θ) = cot θ. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 sin(90°−θ) = cos θ and cos(90°−θ) = sin θ
💡 tan(90°−θ) = cot θ and cot(90°−θ) = tan θ
💡 sec(90°−θ) = cosec θ and cosec(90°−θ) = sec θ
💡 Useful for simplifying expressions like sin 72° = cos 18°
